sources.author: Harrison Chase
sources.headline: Co-founder & CEO at LangChain
sources.post_summary: Discussed the rapid evolution of AI agents, highlighting how LangGraph enables reliable multi-step workflows and the shift from simple chatbots to production-grade agent systems. Emphasized the importance of observability and human-in-the-loop controls for enterprise adoption.

sources.author: Simon Willison
sources.headline: Independent AI researcher & creator of Datasette
sources.post_summary: Shared insights on building lightweight AI tooling for developers, covering new open-source libraries that simplify prompt engineering and evaluation. Stressed the need for transparent, auditable infrastructure when deploying agents at scale.

sources.author: Sarah Guo
sources.headline: Founder at Conviction & AI investor
sources.post_summary: Analyzed the current AI infrastructure landscape, noting that compute costs and latency remain the biggest bottlenecks for agentic systems. Highlighted emerging startups focused on specialized inference and orchestration layers.

sources.author: Adam Selipsky
sources.headline: CEO at Amazon Web Services
sources.post_summary: Outlined AWS's latest updates for AI automation, including new Bedrock agent capabilities and serverless options that reduce operational overhead for developers building intelligent workflows.

sources.author: Elena Voss
sources.headline: GTM Engineer @ Ramp | Ex-Notion
sources.post_summary: Discussed building a GTM engineering function that sits between product and sales, using data pipelines to identify expansion opportunities and automate lead qualification. Shared how her team reduced manual research time by 60% through custom scoring models.

sources.author: Marcus Chen
sources.headline: Head of Revenue Operations @ Deel
sources.post_summary: Explained how his team implemented outbound automation sequences that integrate intent signals with CRM data, resulting in a 3x increase in meeting book rates. Emphasized the importance of clean data foundations before layering automation.

sources.author: Priya Sharma
sources.headline: Content Strategy Lead @ Webflow | Former HubSpot
sources.post_summary: Shared a framework for aligning content strategy with revenue operations by mapping content assets to specific stages of the buyer journey and sales funnel. Highlighted how content can reduce sales cycle length when used as a GTM lever.

sources.author: David Kim
sources.headline: Founder & CEO @ Clay
sources.post_summary: Posted about the evolution of outbound automation tools and how modern GTM teams are moving beyond basic email sequences to multi-channel, intent-driven workflows. Included examples of how teams are operationalizing data enrichment at scale.

sources.author: Sarah Patel
sources.headline: VP Sales Operations @ Notion
sources.post_summary: Detailed how her team built a revenue operations dashboard that connects marketing attribution, sales activity, and customer success metrics. Stressed the need for cross-functional alignment between content, sales, and ops teams.

sources.author: Alex Finn
sources.headline: Solo Founder @ Finny | Ex-Google
sources.post_summary: Shared his journey building Finny solo over 8 months, detailing the decision to quit Google, the first paying customer milestone, and lessons on customer interviews before coding. Emphasized the value of public accountability in staying consistent.

sources.author: Priya Sharma
sources.headline: Indie Hacker & ex-Marketer turned Developer
sources.post_summary: Documented her career pivot from marketing into software engineering by building and shipping three small SaaS tools in public. Highlighted how sharing weekly progress helped her land freelance clients and build a portfolio without formal credentials.

sources.author: Marcus Lee
sources.headline: Founder @ ShipFast | Writing about product & growth
sources.post_summary: Posted a thread breaking down how he shipped a new feature in 4 days using no-code tools and customer feedback loops. Focused on the tradeoffs between speed and polish when bootstrapping alone.

sources.author: Elena Voss
sources.headline: Software Engineer & Content Creator
sources.post_summary: Shared her transition from non-tech roles into development by open-sourcing side projects and documenting the process weekly. Noted how transparent updates attracted both job offers and early users for her current product.
